title: Investigation 03: Frictionless Parimutuel Odds vs. Poisson Memory & NTS Distortion
summary_bullets: ArXiv 2610.29847v1 Theorem: Under Poisson memory recall, manipulation backfires on sparse memories but drives high-memory Bayesian agents to arbitrarily confident beliefs in the wrong state.
ArXiv 2610.26746v1 Empirical Calibration: A 40% scale shift in Normal Tempered-Stable returns distorts cumulative decision weights by 7 to 8 percentage points across S&P 500 data.
Parimutuel Invalidation Gate: When surface conditions shift (8.4% sloppy dirt), frictionless historical recall maximizes conviction in obsolete speed figures.

collisions.essay_target: Essay 3: The Frictionless Life & Parimutuel Probability Math
collisions.bridge: Poisson Memory Right-Tail Thickening vs. Racetrack Hot-Hand & Sloppy-Track Blindness
collisions.synthesis: Demonstrates why frictionless high-volume recall increases vulnerability to regime shifts unless gated by a deliberate human PASS rule.
